messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not take prednisone if you have a systemic fungal infection, which is a fungal infection that has spread through your body.
Prednisone weakens your immune system. This makes it easier to get an infection; an existing infection may become worse and can reactivate an old infection, such as tuberculosis or hepatitis B. It can also hide the usual signs of infection, so an infection may be advanced before you notice it. Tell your doctor about any illness or infection you have had in the past few weeks.
Stay away from people who are sick. Chickenpox and measles can be serious or even fatal in someone taking a steroid. Call your doctor straight away if you are exposed to either one.
Do not have a live vaccine while you are taking prednisone unless your doctor says it is safe.
Do not stop taking prednisone suddenly after more than a few days of treatment. Your body needs time to start making its own steroid hormones again. Your doctor will lower your dose in steps.
Triplet: ["prednisone", "weakens", "immune system"]

The relation 'weakens' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may reduce the effectiveness or strength of the biological system or function specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'reduces response to': The subject drug may decrease the effectiveness or response to the object entity.
B. 'has reduced efficacy in': The subject drug may be less effective in patients with the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'helps reduce': The subject drug is used to decrease or lessen the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
E. 'blocks': The subject drug inhibits or prevents the function of the receptor or pathway specified by the object entity.
